summary.description: One or two sentences on what was changed overall.

commit_message.description: Conventional commit subject (72 characters or fewer), a blank line, then a short body.

id.description: The finding's id, exactly as given.

status.description: wrong: the finding is mistaken (for example the oracle does what ts-r does); nothing was changed for it.

explanation.description: Posted on the finding's thread: what changed and why, or why it was not fixed.

files.description: Repository paths changed for this finding; empty when not fixed.

checks.description: What was run for this finding through box-run, one line each with its result: the oracle on the finding's input and what it printed, then builds and tests with their exit status. Empty when nothing was run.
